_comment: Regression test for https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/11244 - `hook.js` and `other.js` both import `memo` from the side-effect-free external `dep`. Tree-shaking drops the only use in `hook.js`, but `other.js` still uses it. The external binding is shared by both importers, so `hook.js` kept `import { memo } from "dep"`. Each chunk must only import the external symbols that its included statements reference.
